"""Bounded, synthetic triage evaluation; no collectors or production DB writes."""
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.request

from project_registry_core import database, editorial, enrichment_pipeline, llm_transport, project_record, registry

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = OUT.parents[1]

def write(name, data):
    (OUT / name).write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')

def digest(text):
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()

settings = {}
allowed = {'ATPROTO_SURVEY_LLM_ENDPOINT', 'ATPROTO_SURVEY_LLM_MODEL', 'ATPROTO_SURVEY_LLM_API_KEY'}
for line in Path('.envrc').read_text().splitlines():
    parts = shlex.split(line, comments=True)
    if len(parts) == 2 and parts[0] == 'export' and '=' in parts[1]:
        key, value = parts[1].split('=', 1)
        if key in allowed:
            settings[key] = value
assert settings['ATPROTO_SURVEY_LLM_MODEL'] == 'qwen/qwen3.6-35b-a3b', 'Model changed; do not migrate implicitly'
os.environ['ATPROTO_SURVEY_LLM_TIMEOUT'] = '180'
os.environ.pop('ATPROTO_SURVEY_LLM_COMMAND', None)

cases = {c['id']: c for c in json.loads((OUT/'inputs.json').read_text())}
schedule = json.loads((OUT/'schedule.json').read_text())
template = (OUT/'prompt.txt').read_text()
ledger_path = OUT/'attempts.json'
ledger = json.loads(ledger_path.read_text()) if ledger_path.exists() else []
conn = database.open_database(OUT/'application.db',create=True)
for case_id, repeat in schedule:
    key = f'{case_id}-{repeat}'
    if (OUT/f'{key}.json').exists(): continue
    assert len(ledger)<6 and not any(a['key']==key for a in ledger)
    case=cases[case_id]
    p=copy.deepcopy(case['project'])
    _, full_evidence=registry.build_triage_prompt(p)
    evidence={k: full_evidence[k] for k in ('current_profile','description_sources')}
    evidence['name']=p['name']
    prompt=template.replace('{{evidence_json}}',json.dumps(evidence,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
    (OUT/f'{key}-prompt.txt').write_text(prompt)
    ledger.append(dict(key=key,status='started'))
    write('attempts.json',ledger)
    metrics=[]
    try:
        payload,meta=llm_transport.run_llm_with_metrics(prompt,purpose='description_only_experiment',requests=metrics,
            prompt_version='description-only-experiment-v1',
            llm_endpoint=settings['ATPROTO_SURVEY_LLM_ENDPOINT'],llm_model=settings['ATPROTO_SURVEY_LLM_MODEL'],
            llm_api_key=settings['ATPROTO_SURVEY_LLM_API_KEY'],llm_api_style='responses',
            llm_reasoning_effort='none',llm_max_output_tokens=2048)
    except Exception as exc:
        ledger[-1].update(status='failed',error_type=type(exc).__name__,metrics=metrics)
        write('attempts.json',ledger)
        print(json.dumps(ledger[-1]),flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(1)
    meta.pop('endpoint',None);meta.pop('resolved_endpoint',None)
    assert set(payload)=={'tagline','summary','features','description_change'}
    proposed={
        'tagline':registry.normalize_tagline(payload['tagline']),
        'summary':project_record.normalize_ja_en_mixed_spacing(payload['summary'].strip()),
        'features':registry.clean_human_string_list(payload['features'],limit=6)}
    applied={}
    for protection in ('automatic','unknown','operator','modified_after_automatic','unknown_matching_prior_output'):
        q=copy.deepcopy(p);q['project_key']+='-'+key+'-'+protection
        if protection.startswith('unknown'):q.pop('editorial',None)
        if protection=='unknown_matching_prior_output':q['llm_output']=editorial.profile(q)
        if protection=='operator':editorial.record_edit(q,allow_automatic=False,updated_at='2026-09-22T00:00:00+00:00')
        if protection=='modified_after_automatic':q['editorial']['profile_hash']='previous-different-profile-hash'
        before=editorial.profile(q)
        before_other={k:copy.deepcopy(v) for k,v in q.items() if k not in (*editorial.FIELDS,'editorial','tagline_is_provisional')}
        editorial.apply_proposal(q,proposed,payload['description_change'],evidence['description_sources'],generated_at=meta['generated_at'])
        assert before_other=={k:v for k,v in q.items() if k in before_other}
        project_record.save_project(conn,q);conn.commit()
        loaded=project_record.fetch_project(conn,q['project_key'])
        assert editorial.profile(loaded)==editorial.profile(q)
        assert loaded['editorial']==q['editorial']
        assert loaded['tracking_state']==p['tracking_state']
        if protection!='automatic':
            assert editorial.profile(loaded)==before and not editorial.automatic(loaded)
        applied[protection]=dict(before=before,after=editorial.profile(loaded),editorial=loaded['editorial'],tracking_state=loaded['tracking_state'])
    result=dict(case=case_id,repeat=repeat,real_llm=True,experimental_path=True,evidence=evidence,
        full_triage_evidence=full_evidence,prompt_sha256=digest(prompt),template_sha256=digest(template),suffix='',
        output=payload,meta=meta,metrics=metrics,applied=applied,
        git_head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),
        input_sha256=digest(json.dumps(case,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True)))
    write(f'{key}.json',result)
    ledger[-1]['status']='complete';write('attempts.json',ledger)
    print(json.dumps(dict(key=key,output=payload,usage=meta.get('usage'),metrics=metrics),ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
assert conn.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchone()[0]=='ok'
assert not conn.execute('PRAGMA foreign_key_check').fetchall()
conn.close()
